records.subject: Hybrid ionic/electronic thermoelectric converter (HTEC)
records.quote: Instead of enhancing the figure of merit (ZT) of thermoelectric materials, a significant improvement in heat harvesting by constructing a hybrid ionic/electronic thermoelectric converter (HTEC) is demonstrated.
context_quotes: The device consists of an electronic unit and an ionic unit.
The electronic unit is made of a thermoelectric polymer, poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrene sulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS), and the ionic unit is composed of an ionogel.
